title: Warehouse menu ordering lives in json_warehouse_rows; running warehouses first, API order kept within each group
answers: where is the running warehouse ordering in mlflow agent setup
why are running SQL warehouses listed first in the setup wizard
how does the warehouse selection menu sort warehouses
where to change warehouse order in agent setup
body:
The warehouse selection menu gets its order from mlflow/agent/setup/setup.sh:json_warehouse_rows, which buffers rows whose state is RUNNING and rows in any other state separately, then prints the running group followed by the rest in its END block.
select_warehouse calls json_warehouse_rows and builds the menu items from its output; the menu code does not sort on its own.
Within each group the Databricks API order is preserved (rows are stored by index, not sorted), so changing the ordering means changing json_warehouse_rows, not select_warehouse.
The regression test tests/agent/test_setup_sh_unit.py:test_json_warehouse_rows_lists_running_warehouses_first is parametrized over pretty, compact and reordered-field inputs; keep all three when editing the parser.
applies: Ordering and parsing of the SQL warehouse list in the mlflow agent setup wizard only.
says: Why are running SQL warehouses listed at the top in the setup wizard
Change the display order of SQL warehouses in the agent configuration menu

The warehouse selection list preserves original cloud workspace ordering within each status group
Keep active warehouses at the beginning of the picker during agent setup
